model.title: Safe Beaches, Safe Swimmers Act
model.meta: Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Jennifer Kiggans (R-VA)

summary.text: The bill would require the federal government to keep enough lifeguards on duty at swimming areas and beaches it manages, such as those run by the National Park Service, Fish and Wildlife Service, Bureau of Land Management, or Bureau of Reclamation, during their usual seasonal hours. If the Department of the Interior finds it cannot staff a site with federal lifeguards, it could make agreements with local government agencies to provide lifeguards, and it would have to repay those agencies for all reasonable costs. The requirements would not apply to short-term gaps caused by temporary absences, such as an employee taking leave.
